findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_headers, check_page_meta, check_sitemap · Private data: manifest_cost, lint_agent_md, scrub_env, check_sitemap, decode_jwt · Public sink: check_tells, json_to_schema · Destructive: check_tells.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_headers, check_page_meta, check_sitemap · Private data: manifest_cost, lint_agent_md, scrub_env, check_sitemap, decode_jwt · Public sink: check_tells, json_to_schema · Destructive: check_tells

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
